question: Can side-loaded M2 nuts and M2x12 screws fit within bracket rails without cutting the upper load-bearing layer?
criterion_origin: 0.5mm previous nominal screen; one pitch protrusion is engineering geometry screen, not effective thread or strength approval
stop: One specified pocket and fastener selection; retain failure if interference, disconnected geometry or protrusion fails. No strength simulation.
limits: Nut is ideal AF4 hexagonal prism with cylindrical bore, excludes chamfer and thread
Screw shaft is diameter2mm reservation; thread contact intentional
Board insulation, dimensional tolerances, nut insertion sweep, hands and tools excluded
Side-open slot must later prove retention during assembly and resistance to rotation
